items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3NzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--baad0ffa68c853ed34e6b5f7772b1d3f681c2028/IMG_0509.png) ### Welcome to Philippine Championship 2026! The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) proudly presents the 15th World Cube Association National Championship for the **Philippines**, the annual culmination of the best Filipino speedcubers in their respective events. This competition brings together the nation's top talents for an exciting showcase of skill, determination, and sportsmanship. Only the **top three** winners representing the **Philippines** of each category will receive physical awards such as medals and plaques. The top three winners of any Finals, regardless of nationality, will be recognized together with the top three at the awarding ceremony. Looking for 3x3 Fewest Moves? Check out [Philippine FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026). ###### *Page unavailable? The competition hasn't been announced yet. It will be available in the near future.* * All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above. * If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineChampionship2026#73862-registration-payment). * Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating. * Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it. ###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition. Furthermore, by your presence, you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used in any format for any purpose worldwide by the organization team and its partners. This includes your likeness and voice to be included therein without compensation, credit, or other consideration. If you do not wish to be photographed, recorded, or appear under these conditions, you should not participate and enter the event premises.*

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTczODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02e6d29a61b0dd2745ee55791e80dd6dccf8b9cd/image.png) ### **Welcome to the first ever Philippine FMC Championship.** This competition will determine the **2026 Philippine National Champion** for **3x3 Fewest Moves**. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look at [Philippine Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineChampionship2026). --- ### Locations See [Location tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026#73905-locations) for more details. --- *Additional locations may be added until 14 days before the competition starts, so stay tuned for updates!*
